name: Kingdom of Gaochang
native: 麴氏王國 (Qushi Wangguo, the Qu kingdom)

predecessors.name: Northern Liang
predecessors.text: Gaochang, where the Northern Liang remnants led by Juqu Wuhui and Juqu Anzhou 'fled to Gaochang' in 439 and ruled until 460

successors.name: Tang dynasty
successors.text: Gaochang, 'annexed by the Chinese Tang dynasty and turned into a sub-prefecture of Xizhou' on 19 September 640

ledger.x: 460: the Rouran install Kan Bozhou as king of Gaochang.
460: the Gaochang kings rule as Rouran vassals.
481: the Fufuluo (Gaoche) break the Rouran hold.

c. 488: the Kan family gives way to the Zhang. The Gaoche king killed Kan Shougui ('478-488?' or '478-491?') and 'Gaochang thus passed under Gaoche rule'; Zhang Mengming '488?-496' follows. Year uncertain by the page itself.

c. 488: Gaochang passes under Gaoche rule. The Gaoche king A-Fuzhiluo 'killed King Kan Shougui, who was the nephew of Kan Bozhou', 'appointed a Han from Dunhuang, named Zhang Mengming' and 'Gaochang thus passed under Gaoche rule' (Gaochang page); the reign table dates Kan Shougui '478-488? or 478-491?' and Zhang…
496: the Ma family succeeds the Zhang.
587: the Qu kingdom as a Turkic vassal (bridge).
19 September 640: the Turkic tie ends with the Tang conquest.

wars.name: Gaoche interference in Gaochang
wars.outcome: 'In 481, the Fufuluo began to interfere with the Gaochang and deposed one of their kings'; the Gaoche king A-Fuzhiluo killed Kan Shougui and Gaochang passed under Gaoche rule.

wars.name: Tang conquest of Gaochang
wars.outcome: Taizong sent Hou Junji and Xue Wanjun around the new year of 640; Qu Wentai died, Qu Zhisheng surrendered, Xi Prefecture was set up on 19 September 640.

certainty.note: An oasis kingdom: the pages give a city and its depression, never a frontier; the 640 annexation excepted 'three cities'.

sources.title: Protectorate General to Pacify the West
